description: Use this module to manage crontab variables.

parameters.name: backup
parameters.description: If set, create a backup of the crontab before it is modified. The location of the backup is returned in the backup variable by this module. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: cron_file
parameters.description: If specified, uses this file instead of an individual user’s crontab. Without a leading /, this is assumed to be in /etc/cron.d. With a leading /, this is taken as absolute.

parameters.name: insertafter
parameters.description: If specified, the variable is inserted after the variable specified. Used with state=present.

parameters.name: insertbefore
parameters.description: Used with state=present. If specified, the variable is inserted just before the variable specified.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to ensure that the variable is present or absent. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The specific user whose crontab should be modified. This parameter defaults to root when unset.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set this variable to. Required if state=present.

examples:
- name: Ensure entry like "EMAIL=doug@ansibmod.con.com" exists
  community.general.cronvar:
    name: EMAIL
    value: doug@ansibmod.con.com

- name: Ensure a variable does not exist. This may remove any variable named "LEGACY"
  community.general.cronvar:
    name: LEGACY
    state: absent

- name: Add a variable to a file under /etc/cron.d
  community.general.cronvar:
    name: LOGFILE
    value: /var/log/yum-autoupdate.log
    user: root
    cron_file: ansible_yum-autoupdate
